Asset type: reusable adult portrait clothing overlay for inserting a separate head later.
Canvas/backdrop: SQUARE 1:1 true transparent PNG. Entire upper central third is empty alpha-zero space reserved for a future head. Garment centered below it, shoulders at about 40 percent of canvas height, collar opening centered horizontally, lower clean garment crop ending above the canvas bottom. Keep clear transparent margins on left, right and bottom.
Style: photorealistic clothing product photography, calm warm-neutral soft studio light, believable tailoring, natural fabric folds and familiar real clothing. Straight-on front view with level shoulders, no perspective distortion.
CRITICAL: only clothing fabric and its own buttons or tie. NO head, face, neck, skin, hands, body, human, mannequin, display stand, hanger or filler. The complete head-and-neck area and the interior neck opening MUST be alpha-zero transparent so a separate head can be placed there. No dark or flesh-colored plug filling the collar.
Do not fade solid fabric. No background, tabletop, floor, external shadows, haze, glow, checkerboard, writing, logos, extra accessories or decorative picture frame.
Subject: A women's light-blue denim jacket with a small pointed collar, fitted chest seams, two small patch pockets and plain metal buttons. Show only the garment straight-on from both complete shoulders to the lower chest. Leave the collar opening entirely empty, with no head, neck, skin, arms, hands, body or mannequin.
